historical_reviews.deepseek: Output alone cannot prove expected volume count, backing or correctness.
historical_reviews.gpt_v2: Adds volume/backing/path manifest and prohibits filesystem mutation.
historical_reviews.related_cases: Drive/controller/storage summary rows do not replace logical-volume and filesystem mapping.

original_test_intent: Verify every expected storage volume is present with correct identity, size, backing drives/controllers, RAID/filesystem/mount/path attributes and NVSM health OK.
original_method: Pin NVSM build; preserve diagnostics; load expected volume UUID/name/size/type/backing/path/mount/RAID/filesystem manifest; run exact `nvsm show volumes` read-only; retain raw status/health/properties; compare completeness and relationships to drives/controllers; correlate deviations without mounting, repairing or changing volumes.
manual_activity: Storage owner supplies the expected volume/backing manifest and dispositions every missing, extra, mismatched or non-OK volume.
safety_requirements: Never clear logs, mount, fsck, format, resize or repair volumes
Resolve by stable UUID/identity, not device-node order

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: The query is applicable but lacks expected logical-volume identities, backing relationships and path semantics.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Run the literal command and join every volume to its approved UUID/backing/path manifest.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: All storage volumes, all information and every health state remain in scope.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Create a volume-keyed expected/observed table including size, type, backing graph, path/mount/filesystem and health.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Makes completeness and correctness objective while read-only.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: Healthy drives/controllers do not prove logical volumes or filesystem paths are correct.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Snapshots, multipath and container namespaces can expose alternate volume views; expected scope must be explicit.

project_override_considerations: Storage architecture defines expected logical/physical volume layering, mount namespace and optional volumes.

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: Procedure and Criteria consistently target volume inventory and health; missing reference data are project inputs and log clearing is rejected for safety.

blocked_analysis.analysis: Package and manifest are provisionable; collection is read-only.

review_improvement: Verifies logical-volume backing and paths, preventing healthy physical devices from masking a missing or misassembled volume.
independent_technical_reasoning: Volume correctness depends on its backing graph and stable UUID, not only a display name. A correctly sized volume backed by the wrong drive set or mounted at the wrong path is a distinct failure that drive health cannot reveal.
